input.summary: Make PB's termination right an unconditional convenience exit on 30 days' written notice with pro rata refund of prepayments, and bar SFJ convenience termination during the Term.
input.comment: [Playbook] We need a clear, unconditional customer exit: as drafted PB's at-will right only opens after SFJ has spent $60 million, closes at first Regulatory Approval, and leaves the notice period blank. We have made it an express termination for convenience without cause on thirty (30) days' written notice with a pro rata refund of any PB prepayments, and confirmed SFJ has no convenience termination right during the Term; we have left the 300% Development Cost payment for the Trial Data Package intact, so please note this exit remains costly and we may revert to that pricing separately.

ops.oldText: PB may terminate this Agreement at any time after SFJ has paid or incurred a total of $60 million of Development Costs and prior to the date of receipt of the first Regulatory Approval upon [***] prior written notice to SFJ.
ops.newText: PB may terminate this Agreement for convenience, without cause, at any time upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to SFJ, and SFJ will refund pro rata any fees or other amounts prepaid by PB for the period after the effective date of termination. SFJ has no right to terminate this Agreement for convenience during the Term.
